emerging_technology: Text-to-image diffusion models, with latent diffusion as the reference architecture
intended_application: Generate internal advertising concept images and mood boards for homeware campaigns; final product photographs and advertising copy remain separately authored and checked.
organization: A hypothetical mid-sized U.S. online homeware retailer with 14 marketing and content-operations employees and a designated marketing-operations lead as prospective pilot sponsor.
industry_sector: Consumer homeware retail and digital marketing
business_need: Determine whether the organization can plan, authorize, staff and govern a bounded comparison of AI-assisted INTERNAL campaign concept boards against its current manual/designer workflow; no measured benefit is assumed.
users_stakeholders: Marketing and content-operations staff, merchandising/product catalogue manager, compliance reviewer, marketing-operations sponsor, freelance design partners, and customers who only see final approved assets.
adoption_posture: Moderate/fast-follower; management will authorize a small reversible internal study only when a documented protocol and vendor/input-use terms are accepted.
capabilities_constraints: Assumed organizational strengths for this contrast: a marketing-operations sponsor is designated; a two-person internal evaluation allocation is approved within existing capacity; staff have image-editing skills and a defined concept-approval process; merchandising owns verified reference photos and product specifications; a named content reviewer and budget owner exist; staff are accustomed to documented creative review and change briefings. A documented fallback to the manual/designer process exists. Still unknown: selected vendor, current model/input-use rights, actual AI output accuracy, true staff acceptance and actual measured benefit.
risk_consequence_context: AI-generated images remain internal only. The larger business has named owners and established review, lowering organizational execution exposure, but rights and actual model fidelity remain unresolved and can block trial authorization.
management_question: For the same diffusion-model internal concept-board use, is this staffed organization organizationally ready for an authorized bounded evaluation and future sustained operation? What gaps and formal gates remain?
time_horizon: Six-week readiness review and possible trial-authorization decision, not a deadline to deploy or proof of business value.
additional_context:
CONTRAST 1 - HYPOTHETICAL PROFILE: Sponsor, staff-hour allocation, product-reference data owner, review-owner, budget owner, process checklist and fallback are explicitly assumed to exist. This is NOT evidence of a real organization. No vendor/input rights verified, no pilot executed, no benefit measured. The technology and application are identical to Primary.
